title: EvoLingo Lesson Content JSON Cheatsheet
purpose: Typed reference for every lesson-reading content component. This file documents component types and meanings; docs/lesson-content.schema.json is the formal validation schema.

conventions.contentFormat: Each section uses a `title` and preferably a `blocks` array. Each block is an object with a required `type`. If `blocks` is omitted, the current UI supports the legacy `body`, `rows`, `examples`, and `tip` fields.
conventions.sourceOfTruth: When `blocks` exists, the renderer uses it instead of the legacy fields. Do not duplicate the same content in both shapes.
conventions.text: A component's text field can be a string or an array of marked text runs.
conventions.noRawHtml: Do not put HTML, JSX, CSS, or React component syntax in lesson JSON.
conventions.typography: Let the UI establish text size and spacing. Do not add visual-only paragraphs or repeated punctuation to imitate layout.
conventions.images: Use an existing repository asset or a verified URL, a meaningful alt description, and a layout suited to the content.

marks.bold: Strong text for grammar terms and key rules.
marks.italic: Light emphasis for titles or contrast.
marks.underline: Underline a term when semantics warrant it; use sparingly.
marks.highlight: Subtle neutral-gray highlight behind a short phrase.
marks.code: Monospace treatment for exact grammar patterns, tokens, or literal syntax.
marks.muted: Secondary text that should be visually quieter but remain readable.

hero.meaning: Primary illustration near the beginning of a lesson or concept.
hero.imagePlacement: Large image above/below its associated text.
hero.recommendedUse: One main image that establishes the subject.
hero.textField: Optional; when present, appears below the image.

full.meaning: Large image spanning the available lesson content width.
full.recommendedUse: Diagrams, timelines, screenshots, or visual references.

contained.meaning: Centered image with a narrower maximum width.
contained.recommendedUse: Small diagrams or illustrations that lose clarity when stretched.

split-image-left.meaning: Image left, associated title and text right.
split-image-left.recommendedUse: An illustration paired with one short explanation.

split-image-right.recommendedUse: A text-led explanation with a supporting image on the right.

inline-image-left.meaning: Compact image left, short associated text right.
inline-image-left.recommendedUse: Vocabulary, a small visual hint, or a short reminder.

inline-image-right.meaning: Short associated text left, compact image right.
inline-image-right.imagePlacement: Narrow image column on the right.
inline-image-right.recommendedUse: A text-led reminder with a small illustration.

commonImageFields.src: string, required: URL or public asset path for the image.
commonImageFields.alt: string, required: concise description of the image's relevant meaning.
commonImageFields.layout: one of hero | full | contained | split-image-left | split-image-right | inline-image-left | inline-image-right; defaults to full.
commonImageFields.title: optional string, short heading attached to the image.
commonImageFields.text: optional LessonText, associated explanation (required in practice for split/inline layouts).
commonImageFields.caption: optional string, source or context caption.

paragraph.definition: Primary explanatory text. Prefer 1–3 sentences per block.

example.text: A **Present Simple** szokásokat és általános igazságokat ír le.

heading.definition: A subheading within a section. Use a heading to organize a longer explanation, not for every paragraph.

example.definition: A target-language sample sentence, optionally paired with a translation and explanatory note. Rendered as prominent text with a subtle left rule, not as a heavy card.

table.definition: Structured row-and-column reference for forms, endings, usage, or comparisons.

required.rows: array of string arrays; all rows should use the same number of cells

callout.definition: A short note that deserves extra attention: tip, reminder, warning, or confirmation. Use sparingly.

example.title: Figyelj erre
example.text: He, she és it esetén általában **-s** vagy **-es** kerül az igére.

list.definition: A short group of related items, sequence steps, or checklist criteria.

image.definition: A meaningful illustration, diagram, or supporting visual. Image placement is controlled by `layout`.

example.alt: A diák heti naptára, szombatra jelölt futballal
example.title: Rendszeresen ismétlődő szokás
example.text: A szokásokat often, usually vagy every Saturday kifejezésekkel is leírhatjuk.
example.caption: Illusztráció a rendszeres cselekvésekhez.

image.note: The example path is a placeholder. Replace it with a real verified asset before using it.

quote.definition: A memorable phrase, sample sentence, or rule shown with a quiet editorial quote treatment.

example.text: She doesn't like it. — a doesn't után az ige alapformában áll.

formula.definition: A concise grammar pattern or reusable construction. Use this rather than a table for a single formula.

example.label: Present Simple — állító forma
example.explanation: He, she és it esetén az igéhez általában -s vagy -es kerül.

vocabulary.definition: A compact glossary of terms or words with meanings and optional examples.

required.items: array of objects with term and meaning

optional.itemExample: example is optional on each vocabulary item

items.example: I usually get up at seven.

comparison.definition: Two short, related groups displayed side by side on wider screens and stacked on small screens.

divider.definition: A subtle separator between distinct topics. Omit the label when no text is needed.

legacySectionFields.body: string: one basic paragraph. Prefer blocks for new or rewritten sections.
legacySectionFields.rows: [[left, right], ...]: legacy format converted to a two-column table.
legacySectionFields.examples: [{ sentence, translation }, ...]: legacy format converted to example blocks.
legacySectionFields.tip: string: legacy format converted to a tip callout.

blocks.text: Az **I, you, we, they** után az ige alapformája áll.

blocks.title: Gyakori hiba
blocks.text: Helyesen: **She doesn't like it.** A doesn't után az ige alapformája marad.

arrange.definition: Learner arranges word tokens into the target sentence.
